ops.text: Correction to the previous entry: the wedged controller state is ~/.cc-review/v1/services.db (daemonkit StatePath — desired service set, deliberately never governed by ArchiveUnsupportedSchema per controller.go:41-46), not processes.db (ProcessPath, which the archive policy does govern). processes.db was restored untouched. The upgrade-path gap stands: cc-review's daemonkit-v0.14 migration needs explicit services.db schema-upgrade handling (bucket backfill or a guided archive), else every pre-v0.14 install errors on all commands with no remedy hint. E2E workaround: services.db → services.db.v010.bak.
